scope: Selected configuration-specific records, not an exhaustive benchmark or cross-paper leaderboard.

regimes.learner: FP8 GEMMs with unified precision flow
regimes.rollout: FP8 execution coordinated with the learner path
regimes.collection: Updated actor weights transfer to the inference engine after each step; vLLM and verl implementation
regimes.boundary: Operator-level FP8 does not imply that every module and training state is FP8.

regimes.learner: Higher-precision learner; v2 also explores end-to-end FP8
regimes.rollout: Native W8A8 linear layers; FP8 attention and KV extensions
regimes.collection: Step-wise rollout/training workflow with dynamic QKV-scale recalibration
regimes.boundary: The representative rollout recipe and the end-to-end FP8 exploration have different learner precision; each extension has its own precision exceptions and calibration cost.

regimes.learner: Rollout-aligned fake quantization in the learner forward
regimes.rollout: W8A8 and W4A16 configurations; W4A8 in quantization ablations
regimes.collection: Quantized rollout and aligned learner under TBPO; numerical targets are tested across model regimes
regimes.boundary: KV quantization is excluded; QAT should not be read as a measured native low-bit trainer speedup.

regimes.rollout: HiFloat4 and MXFP4 with Rollout-ResQ activation compensation
regimes.boundary: Simulation overhead prevents direct measurement of native-FP4 speedup.

regimes.rollout: NVFP4 W4A4 routed experts + NVFP4 KV in softmax attention; other modules BF16
regimes.collection: Asynchronous; routing replay and importance correction retained
regimes.boundary: No native-FP4 trainer acceleration is established.

regimes.learner: Native NVFP4 W4A4 forward; higher-precision training state remains
regimes.rollout: Native W4A4; KV is BF16 in documented characterization
regimes.collection: Synchronous math RL on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-30B-A3B
regimes.boundary: No KV4 experiment or direct SC/TIS+SC comparison is reported.

regimes.rollout: Quantization stress includes FP4 KV and INT8 sampler with INT4 KV
regimes.collection: Quantization and policy-lag tests are separate settings
regimes.boundary: Shared-objective controls and training-accuracy curves are not full-recipe replications or a universal held-out ranking.

regimes.rollout: INT4 KV with bounded INT8 protection; cache-focused execution
regimes.collection: Quota-based partial collection; generation and learning alternate
regimes.boundary: Common BF16 evaluation isolates learned-policy quality; no joint W4A4/KV4 training result is established.

comparisons.title: TRACE versus TIS+SC
comparisons.setting: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B; joint NVFP4 expert W/A and KV rollout; four reasoning/code benchmarks
comparisons.compared: TRACE; TIS+SC (cap 2, top-128 reconstruction); BF16 reference
comparisons.outcome: Reported task mean: TRACE 75.3; TIS+SC 74.1; BF16 74.9.
comparisons.checkpoint_rule: SC is selected by its highest four-task mean through 400 training steps.
comparisons.limit: TRACE and TIS+SC each lead on two of the four tasks; Table 6 provides no uncertainty interval. This is not a TRIAGE comparison.

comparisons.title: TRIAGE versus TIS under native W4A4
comparisons.setting: Qwen3-30B-A3B; synchronous math RL; native NVFP4 W4A4 forward
comparisons.compared: BF16; native NVFP4; NVFP4+TIS; full TRIAGE
comparisons.outcome: At step 1700, five-task mean: TRIAGE 70.96; TIS 63.18; BF16 72.41.
comparisons.checkpoint_rule: Stable arms use their final step 1700. Collapsed naive NVFP4 uses the saved step-700 checkpoint.
comparisons.limit: No direct SC/TIS+SC, TRACE or KV4 comparison is reported. Stability is observed only within the evaluated horizon.

comparisons.title: KV4-RL versus cache-precision controls
comparisons.setting: Qwen3-8B-Base; 400 updates; TIS retained; common BF16 evaluation
comparisons.compared: BF16, KV8, unprotected KV4 and selectively protected KV4-RL
comparisons.outcome: Final six-task mean: KV4-RL 52.8, BF16 52.4. Cumulative rollout/full-iteration speedups: 1.80x/1.27x.
comparisons.checkpoint_rule: Final step 400; one training run per precision in the documented 8B learning-curve study, with three evaluation seeds.
comparisons.limit: Evaluation-seed standard deviations do not measure variability across independent training runs. Timing is specific to this collection workload.
